# Mitishell v1.2.0

We've got a launcher, baby!

## New Features

- `mitishell launcher` opens a top-centered launcher on the focused output. It includes installed desktop applications, Mitishell Settings pages, emoji, reminders, power controls, do-not-disturb, and night light when their services are available.
- Launcher search ranks exact, prefix, word-prefix, substring, keyword, acronym, and bounded typo matches. An empty search leads with the five most recently launched applications.
- Queries beginning with `=` work as a calculator. It supports parentheses, unary signs, decimal values, `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `%`, and right-associative powers. Activating a valid result copies it to the clipboard.
- Launcher history is stored privately under `$XDG_STATE_HOME/mitishell/launcher-recents.json`, or `~/.local/state/mitishell/launcher-recents.json` when `XDG_STATE_HOME` is unset.
- `mitishell keybinds` opens a read-only viewer for every binding reported by Hyprland. It keeps duplicate bindings, groups global and named submaps, shows special flags, and refreshes after Hyprland reloads its configuration.

## Fixes

- The Media Widget now has consistent left and right padding.

## Install

Download the archive matching your system and `SHA256SUMS` from this release. Then run:

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
tar -xzf mitishell-v1.2.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz    # or mitishell-v1.2.0-linux-arm64.tar.gz
cd mitishell-v1.2.0-linux-amd64
make install-prebuilt
quickshell -n -p ~/.local/share/mitishell/shell
```
